description: This is a frozen mountain landscape seen from above. On the left are grey snow-capped mountains and a glacier tongue; on the right is open white snowfield and pale teal pack ice. Repaint so the mountains and glacier taper and break apart gradually as they go right — ridges lowering into foothills, the glacier fraying into snow drifts and ice patches — dissolving naturally into the open snowfield and pack ice. No straight edge, no rectangular block, no abrupt change in snow texture or tone; one continuous frozen wilderness. Keep the same white, grey and pale-teal palette and pixel-art style.
